map_features.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

map_features.note: OSW reference corridor from a selected Barents Sea opening northward-departure approach at 73 N, west of Bear Island and Svalbard, to a selected pre-branching gate near 79.6 N. Excludes upstream Norwegian Atlantic routes, eastward Barents inflow, offshore Front Current feeder, westward recirculation, shelf/fjord intrusions and downstream Svalbard/Yermak/Yermak Pass branches. No whole connected Arctic pathway length.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

reference_routes.name: West Spitsbergen Current

ordering_sensitivity.interpretation: Conservative positions within retained rounded route envelopes, treating choices independently; touching envelopes overlap. Not a statistical rank interval or a uniform whole-current comparison.

remaining_gates: Review southern Barents departure and northern pre-branch naming gates before length admission.
Validate the corridor against shelf/slope bathymetry, velocity fields and finer coastlines; coarse land clearance alone is insufficient.
Resolve Spitsbergen Atlantic naming and northern branch identities separately; no aliases or branch lengths admitted.
Obtain dated geometry and consistent width boundaries before seasonal playback, annual ranges or current-state footprint joins.
Canonical admission and publication review.
reference_routes.scope: OSW reference corridor from a selected Barents Sea opening northward-departure approach at 73 N, west of Bear Island and Svalbard, to a selected pre-branching gate near 79.6 N. Excludes upstream Norwegian Atlantic routes, eastward Barents inflow, offshore Front Current feeder, westward recirculation, shelf/fjord intrusions and downstream Svalbard/Yermak/Yermak Pass branches. No whole connected Arctic pathway length.
reference_routes.source_locator: Introduction and Figure 1: Atlantic flow splits between Scandinavia and Svalbard into Barents inflow via Bear Island Trough and northward WSC continuation; shelf/slope components differ.

supporting_sources.citation: Menze et al. (2019), Atlantic Water Pathways Along the North-Western Svalbard Shelf Mapped Using Vessel-Mounted Current Profilers, JGR Oceans, doi:10.1029/2018JC014299.
supporting_sources.locator: Abstract; sections 4.3 and 6: northward boundary flow at 79-80 N / 5-10 E, splitting into Svalbard, Yermak and Yermak Pass branches.
supporting_sources.role: Northern branch-region context; summer composite does not establish all branches at every time.

supporting_sources.locator: Introduction; sections 2.1-2.2 and code/data availability: separate slope/front branches, 77.25 N target section and limited season coverage.
supporting_sources.role: Source-specific naming and section/season caveats; transect distances are not current length or width.

widths.boundary_rule: Tube 1: first transport-density drop on either side of core below AW thickness times 0.04 m/s; C offshore edge x=-11 km from SADCP. Separate 0.02/0.08 m/s sensitivity cases.
widths.extraction_method: Transcribed original PDF Table 2 cells after rendering and visual inspection; numeric methods read. No new inversion or geographic edge digitization.
widths.geographic_scope: Section A northwest/north of Svalbard, August 2015; local WSC stream-tube support. C is upstream of branch partitioning; tube 2 constrains a Svalbard-branch interpretation.
widths.layer: Property-defined Atlantic Water (practical salinity >34.88; corresponding rounded absolute salinity >35.05 g/kg; conservative temperature >=2 C), limited by seabed; not a fixed depth interval.
widths.name: West Spitsbergen Current
widths.range_interpretation: Threshold cases describe boundary-choice sensitivity, not confidence limits, temporal variation or annual extrema. Tube definitions cannot be averaged or added.

widths.boundary_rule: Published selected-core transport threshold operator; Q maxima east of x=275 km and section selection above their 60th percentile. Exact numerical threshold and selected count unextracted.
widths.extraction_method: Published point and standard deviation transcribed after visual PDF inspection; no per-section reconstruction or boundary digitization.
widths.geographic_scope: Local WSC core at the 77.25 N glider target transect west of Svalbard; selected high-transport sections, not the entire WSC system.
widths.layer: Vertically integrated Q across the sampled water column, independent of water-mass classification; gliders sample to 1000 m or above local seabed. Not a fixed-depth width.
widths.name: West Spitsbergen Current
widths.range_interpretation: No width range is admitted. The separately reported 7 km standard deviation describes western-boundary variability, not minimum/maximum, confidence limits, measurement error or annual extrema.
remaining_gates: Independent scientific admission.
Recover the authors exact selection, estimator, per-section widths and geographical edges for reproducibility and physical map bands.
Obtain comparable observations across missing seasons before annual extrema or seasonal geometry.
widths.section_orientation: Zonal target section; northward geostrophic component is section-normal. No flow-vector correction or geographic width-edge pair extracted.
widths.source_citation: Dundas, V. and Fer, I. (2026), Atlantic Water flow through Fram Strait to the Arctic Ocean measured by repeated glider transects, Ocean Science 22, 1003-1021, doi:10.5194/os-22-1003-2026.
widths.source_locator: Section 3.1, printed p.1008 (PDF page 6), right column; methods sections 2.1-2.5, pp.1005-1008; Table 1 p.1006.
widths.source_quality_note: Rounded source statistic for selected sections. Objective mapping and satellite reference are method components; not direct edge observations or independent seasonal coverage.
widths.standard_deviation_interpretation: Author-reported western-boundary variability of the selected core-width estimate; not confidence limits, physical-boundary error, annual extrema or seasonal range.
widths.time_convention: Table 1 target-section windows across three missions; discontinuous occupations, primarily autumn/winter. Individual width-selection membership unextracted.
